title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-10-15
headline: Canadian writer Anne Carson wins the Nobel Prize in Literature

questions.prompt: Who won the Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.hintKo: The Swedish Academy named Anne Carson.

hintI18n.en: The Swedish Academy named Anne Carson.
hintI18n.zh-Hans: 瑞典学院将安妮·卡森评为获奖者。
hintI18n.ja: スウェーデン・アカデミーはアン・カーソンを選びました。
hintI18n.es: La Academia Sueca nombró a Anne Carson.
hintI18n.hi: स्वीडिश अकादमी ने ऐन कार्सन को चुना।
hintI18n.de: Die Schwedische Akademie wählte Anne Carson aus.
hintI18n.vi: Viện Hàn lâm Thụy Điển đã chọn Anne Carson.
hintI18n.pt-BR: A Academia Sueca escolheu Anne Carson.
hintI18n.fr: L’Académie suédoise a choisi Anne Carson.
hintI18n.it: L'Accademia Svedese ha scelto Anne Carson.

questions.prompt: What did the Academy praise in her work?
choices: Bold inventive writing in playful dialogue with the classical tradition
questions.hintKo: The citation praises inventive work and the classical tradition.

hintI18n.en: The citation praises inventive work and the classical tradition.
hintI18n.ko: 수상 사유는 독창적인 작품과 고전 전통을 칭송합니다.
hintI18n.zh-Hans: 颁奖词赞扬其富有创造性的作品与古典传统。
hintI18n.ja: 授賞理由は独創的な作品と古典の伝統を称えています。
hintI18n.es: La motivación del premio elogia una obra inventiva y la tradición clásica.
hintI18n.hi: प्रशस्ति पत्र रचनात्मक काम और शास्त्रीय परंपरा की प्रशंसा करता है।
hintI18n.de: Die Begründung lobt innovative Arbeit und die klassische Tradition.
hintI18n.vi: Lời tuyên dương ca ngợi tác phẩm sáng tạo và truyền thống cổ điển.
hintI18n.pt-BR: A justificativa elogia o trabalho inventivo e a tradição clássica.
hintI18n.id: Kutipan itu memuji karya inventif dan tradisi klasik.
hintI18n.fr: La citation loue un travail inventif et la tradition classique.
hintI18n.ar: تثني حيثيات الجائزة على العمل الابتكاري والتقليد الكلاسيكي.
hintI18n.tr: Gerekçe, yaratıcı çalışmayı ve klasik geleneği övüyor.
hintI18n.it: La motivazione elogia un'opera inventiva e la tradizione classica.
hintI18n.pl: Uzasadnienie chwali twórczą pracę i tradycję klasyczną.

questions.prompt: When was the literature prize announced?
questions.hintKo: The press release date is the eighth of October.

questions.hintKo: The Academy called her a Canadian author.

hintI18n.en: The Academy called her a Canadian author.

questions.prompt: Why does this prize matter for English learners?
choices: It shows that old stories can still shape new forms of writing
questions.hintKo: The citation is about new forms built with old stories.

hintI18n.en: The citation is about new forms built with old stories.

hintI18n.zh-Hans: 颁奖词讲的是用古老故事构建的新形式。
hintI18n.ja: 授賞理由は古い物語で作られた新しい形式についてです。
hintI18n.es: La motivación trata de nuevas formas construidas con historias antiguas.
hintI18n.hi: प्रशस्ति पत्र पुरानी कहानियों से बने नए रूपों के बारे में है।
hintI18n.de: Die Begründung handelt von neuen Formen, die aus alten Geschichten entstehen.
hintI18n.vi: Lời tuyên dương nói về những hình thức mới được tạo nên từ những câu chuyện cũ.
hintI18n.pt-BR: A justificativa é sobre novas formas construídas com histórias antigas.

hintI18n.fr: La citation porte sur des formes nouvelles construites à partir d’histoires anciennes.

hintI18n.tr: Gerekçe, eski hikâyelerle inşa edilmiş yeni biçimlerle ilgilidir.
hintI18n.it: La motivazione riguarda nuove forme costruite con storie antiche.
hintI18n.pl: Uzasadnienie dotyczy nowych form zbudowanych ze starych opowieści.

questions.prompt: How did the Academy describe her link to old literature?
choices: As a playful dialogue with the classical tradition
questions.hintKo: The exact phrase is playful dialogue with the classical tradition.

hintI18n.en: The exact phrase is playful dialogue with the classical tradition.
hintI18n.ko: 정확한 표현은 고전 전통과의 유쾌한 대화입니다.
hintI18n.zh-Hans: 确切的表述是“与古典传统进行俏皮的对话”。
